mapper.sql: select #{uid} uid,s.id,u.user_name userName,s.top_number ,d.dept_id ,d.dept_name dname,p.dept_name yname, s.user_id, s.top_name, s.top_type,s.party_A,s.party_B, s.first_person_id, s.second_person_id, s.third_person_id, fourth_person_id, s.signing_data, s.validity_Date, concat( s.amount,'万') amount, s.contract, s.filing, s.state,s.createtime from sci_horizontal_apply s left join sys_user u on s.user_id=u.user_id left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_dept p on d.parent_id =p.dept_id
mapper.select:
select #{uid} uid,s.id,u.user_name userName,s.top_number ,d.dept_id,d.dept_name dname,p.dept_name yname, s.user_id, s.top_name, pe.persion_id,pe.ranking,s.top_type,s.party_A,s.party_B, s.first_person_id, s.second_person_id, s.third_person_id, fourth_person_id, s.signing_data, s.validity_Date, concat( s.amount,'万') amount, s.contract, s.filing, s.state,s.createtime from sci_horizontal_apply s left join sci_persion pe on pe.apply_id = s.id left join sys_user u on s.user_id=u.user_id left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_dept p on d.parent_id =p.dept_id where pe.persion_id = #{uid}
and s.state = 'HORIZONTAL_OVER_PASSED'
and s.state in ('HORIZONTAL_APPLY_DRAFT','HORIZONTAL_APPLY_JYS_AUDIT','HORIZONTAL_APPLY_KYC_AUDIT','HORIZONTAL_APPLY_PASSED')
and s.state in ('HORIZONTAL_OVER_DRAFT','HORIZONTAL_OVER_JYS_AUDIT','HORIZONTAL_OVER_KYC_AUDIT','HORIZONTAL_OVER_PASSED','HORIZONTAL_OVER_REJECTED')
and top_name like concat('%', #{topName}, '%') and user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') and d.dept_id = #{dnameId} and p.dept_id = #{ynameId} and d.dept_name like concat('%', #{dname}, '%')
AND YEAR(DATE_ADD(COALESCE(validity_Date, signing_data), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) = #{year}
order by createtime desc

select #{uid} uid,s.id,u.user_name userName,s.top_number ,d.dept_id,d.dept_name dname,p.dept_name yname, s.user_id, s.top_name, s.top_type,s.party_A,s.party_B, s.first_person_id, s.second_person_id, s.third_person_id, fourth_person_id, s.signing_data, s.validity_Date, concat( s.amount,'万') amount, s.contract, s.filing, s.state from sci_horizontal_apply s left join sys_user u on s.user_id=u.user_id left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_dept p on d.parent_id =p.dept_id where 1=1 and top_name like concat('%', #{topName}, '%') and user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') and d.dept_id = #{dnameId} and state = #{state} and YEAR(DATE_ADD(signing_data,INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) = #{year} ${params.dataScope} order by case when state = 'HORIZONTAL_APPLY_JYS_AUDIT' then 1 when state = 'HORIZONTAL_APPLY_KYC_AUDIT' then 2 when state = 'HORIZONTAL_APPLY_PASSED' then 3 else 4 end, createtime desc
